title: Asbury men's, women's soccer look to build off 2024 success - NewsBreak
text:
By Connor Sturgill ,
1 hours ago
WILMORE, Ky. ( FOX 56 ) — The Asbury men’s and women’s soccer teams hosted media day Wednesday evening. The men’s team is looking to build on consecutive ten-win seasons under coach Ben Andrews, who became the program’s all-time winningest coach at the end of last year.
“Over 20 years of coaching, this is the newest team I’ve ever had…and so there’s a lot of teaching for the first time, a lot of acclimation period that’s needed, but we’ve got the group to do it. I mean, these guys are fantastic, great players, even better people, and so they’re hungry, they’re excited. It may take us a little bit, but we’re going to get there this season,” Andrews said.
LATEST SPORTS NEWS:
The women’s team is looking to build off a successful campaign under third-year head coach Zach Welch, led by returning senior and All-American Hannah Muncie.
Both teams were picked to finish fourth in their conference and have a small group of seniors leading the way and looking to defy expectations.
“We’re still green, and we’re still figuring things out. We’re putting people in spots to where you sometimes have veterans, and we don’t necessarily have those in those specific spots, and there’s nothing wrong with that. But that’s an opportunity, and hopefully these players can see that opportunity and take it,” Welch said.
LATEST KENTUCKY NEWS: Both teams open the regular season on Friday. The women face Johnson University-Tennessee at 7 p.m., while the men will face Transylvania University at 5 p.m.
